message.hexkagune.urge_hint: Your kagune lurches toward prey on its own - crouch to restrain it
message.hexkagune.urge_restrained: You force the kagune back under control
message.hexkagune.urge_overpowers: The hunger is stronger than your will
message.hexkagune.kagune_lashes_out: Your kagune lashes out on its own!
message.hexkagune.food_rejected: Your body rejects it. It tastes like ash
message.hexkagune.food_refused: You can't eat that. Only raw flesh feeds a ghoul
message.hexkagune.food_tolerated: Your body tolerates it, but it does nothing for the hunger
message.hexkagune.path.undecided: You have not chosen a kagune path yet
message.hexkagune.path.reset: Your kagune path was cleared - choose again
message.hexkagune.path.choose_first: Your kagune stirs, but it has no shape yet - choose your path
message.hexkagune.ukaku.one_wing_blade: The One-Winged Kagune is a blade - switch back to your wings to throw one
message.hexkagune.ukaku.no_grapple: Ukaku wings don't grab or grapple
message.hexkagune.ukaku.no_threat_auto: Your wings never strike on their own
message.hexkagune.ukaku.crystal_locked: Crystallizing your wings unlocks at mastery %s
message.hexkagune.ukaku.crystal_one_wing: The One-Winged Kagune is crystal already
message.hexkagune.kakuja_kagune_out: Bring your kagune out first to transform (K)
message.hexkagune.king.exhausted: Exhausted: %s can't be called again for %s
message.hexkagune.rinkaku_block.broken: Guard broken - your tails need a moment
message.hexkagune.rinkaku_block.recoveri: Your tails are still recovering from the broken guard
message.hexkagune.impale.recovering: Your tail is still drawing back from the impale
message.hexkagune.impale.no_tail: No tail is free to impale with
message.hexkagune.hurl.recovering: Your tails are still recovering from the last hurl
message.hexkagune.hurl.nothing: Nothing here for your tails to tear up
message.hexkagune.kakuja_autonomous: Your centipede legs fight on their own in the first kakuja - you can only walk (K to change back)
message.hexkagune.ukaku.kakuja_no_wings: Your kakuja is armored tentacles, not wings - turn back with K for that
message.hexkagune.ukaku.gatling_crystal: The Gatling fires crystal spikes - crystallize your wings first (V)
message.hexkagune.ukaku.vortex_crystal: The Wing Vortex is a fire move - thaw your wings first (V)
message.hexkagune.kakugan.locked: Your RC cells haven't woken up yet
message.hexkagune.ghoul.on: Kakugan mode: your eyes open (R again to close them, Ctrl + R to unleash your kagune)
message.hexkagune.ghoul.kakugan_mode: Kakugan mode: kagune in, eyes open (R closes them, Ctrl + R brings the kagune back)
key.hexkagune.kagune_out: Kagune out / all away (hold, then press Manifest)
message.hexkagune.kagune_spent: Your kagune is spent: it stays in for %s seconds
message.hexkagune.pale.kakuja_later: Owl DNA's kakuja comes in a later update
message.hexkagune.pale.not_that_easily: You thought you'd get rid of me that easily?
message.hexkagune.pale.no_tendrils: Owl DNA's flesh doesn't grab like that: J is her flesh, V her kicks, Z her Big Punch
message.hexkagune.graft.no_move: Nothing on that key at this stage
message.hexkagune.graft.no_vault: Nothing behind you to drive the tails into
message.hexkagune.graft.no_prey: Nothing in reach to play with
message.hexkagune.graft.recovering: Your body is knitting: nothing else until it is done (the key again stops it)
message.hexkagune.graft.recovery_spent: Out of RC: the recovery stops
message.hexkagune.graft.kakuja_spent: The kakuja burns out: no RC left to hold it
item.hexkagune.ghoul_meat.lore: §7§oA ghoul's flesh, still dense with RC cells
item.hexkagune.ghoul_meat.human: §4A human body can't keep it down
message.hexkagune.ghoul_meat.eaten: Ghoul meat devoured (%s): strength %s, RC lasts %s
message.hexkagune.ghoul_meat.human: Your body rejects the ghoul's flesh
message.hexkagune.quest.gated: %s needs a quest first: %s (open your quests)
message.hexkagune.quest.closed: §8%s is closed to you now: you chose another way
message.hexkagune.quest.new: §eNew quest: %s §7(open your quests to read it)
message.hexkagune.king.awake: The Dragon is spent. Something is left in you: choose what kind of King you will become.
message.hexkagune.king.not_awake: A final kakuja comes only after the Dragon
message.hexkagune.king.unbuilt: That final kakuja is not ready yet
message.hexkagune.king.chosen: You chose %s. It takes you now. From here on, hold K to call it out and to put it away.
message.hexkagune.king.choose_first: Choose your final kakuja first: War or Peace (the cards, from your kagune menu)
message.hexkagune.king.spent: Your RC is spent: %s falls away from you. Nothing comes out for %s seconds
item.hexkagune.quinque.ghoul: §cCuts ghouls deep and stops their regeneration a while
item.hexkagune.quinque.close: §8Use (tap): fold it back into its case
item.hexkagune.quinque.dawn.lore: §7§oA black lance carried by the White Reaper
item.hexkagune.quinque.bikaku.lore: §7§oA blade grown from a Bikaku kakuhou: balanced, segmented, sharp
item.hexkagune.quinque.koukaku.lore: §7§oA great spear hardened from a Koukaku kakuhou: long, quick, gripped in both hands
item.hexkagune.quinque.katana.lore: §7§oA katana drawn from a Bikaku kakuhou: two hands, one clean cut
item.hexkagune.quinque.mace.lore: §7§oA Rinkaku kakuhou left to grow: a lump of living flesh on a long handle
item.hexkagune.quinque.launcher.lore: §7§oAn Ukaku kakuhou caged in steel: it spits crystal
item.hexkagune.quinque.combo: §8Third hit in a row: a finisher
item.hexkagune.quinque.fire: §8Use (hold): fire crystal shards · Sneak + use: fold it back into its case
item.hexkagune.quinque.dawn_fire: §8Use: its point opens and a lightning ball flies · Sneak + use: fold it back into its case
item.hexkagune.arm.tendril_whip.lore: §7§oA Rinkaku tendril grown out of a bone handle: it cuts, and it catches
item.hexkagune.arm.crystal_spear.lore: §7§oA shaft of dark bone crowned with Ukaku crystal: thrown, it grows back
item.hexkagune.arm.flesh_hammer.lore: §7§oA swollen mass of Koukaku flesh on a jointed bone handle: slow, and it shakes the ground
item.hexkagune.arm.bone_greatsword.lore: §7§oA serrated blade of Bikaku bone with a living spine of flesh: its cuts bleed
item.hexkagune.arm.tendril_whip.moves: §8Use: Bind (catch a foe and slam them down) · Sneak + use: Flay · Sneak + attack: Tendril Swing (lash a block, fly to it)
item.hexkagune.arm.crystal_spear.moves: §8Use: Crystal Javelin · Sneak + use: Piercing Charge
item.hexkagune.arm.flesh_hammer.moves: §8Use: Quake · Sneak + use: Whirlwind · Sneak + attack: Fault Line (the ground breaks open ahead)
item.hexkagune.arm.bone_greatsword.moves: §8Use: Leaping Cut · Sneak + use: Cleave (leaves them bleeding) · Sneak + attack: Bone Wall (guard; parry on time)
item.hexkagune.arm.string: §8Attack: its long string of blows, one after another
item.hexkagune.arm.open: §8Use: tear the weapon out of its case
item.hexkagune.arm.put_away: §8Put it away (another slot) and it folds back into its case
item.hexkagune.human_meat.about: §7§oRaw flesh, a strip of skin still on it. What a ghoul lives on.
item.hexkagune.cooked_human_meat.about: §7§oSeared on the outside, still red within. The start of nearly every recipe here.
item.hexkagune.cooked_ghoul_meat.about: §7§oAnother ghoul's flesh, seared black. It keeps all of its RC, and so do you.
item.hexkagune.human_mince.about: §7§oChopped fine for buns, dumplings and anything rolled.
item.hexkagune.blood_bottle.about: §7§oPressed from the meat and corked. Cooks with it; the bottle comes back.
item.hexkagune.blood_sugar.about: §7§oSugar set with blood. A ghoul's coffee is never served without them.
item.hexkagune.rc_broth.about: §7§oGhoul meat simmered down until the water itself is dense with RC.
item.hexkagune.seared_sandwich.about: §7§oBread round seared meat. Simple, and it fills.
item.hexkagune.club_sandwich.about: §7§oStacked three high and cut in two, a pick through each.
item.hexkagune.blood_toast.about: §7§oToast spread thick with sweetened blood. Breakfast.
item.hexkagune.meat_bun.about: §7§oSoft white dough round a sweet meat filling, steamed.
item.hexkagune.anteiku_burger.about: §7§oThe café's own: a thick patty, beet and greens in a toasted bun.
item.hexkagune.sausage_roll.about: §7§oBlood sausage baked in a golden roll. Eaten on the run.
item.hexkagune.ghoul_sandwich.about: §7§oSeared ghoul meat between two slices. It tastes of iron and power.
item.hexkagune.kakuja_burger.about: §7§oTwo patties, one human, one ghoul. Not for the faint of heart.
item.hexkagune.flatbread_wrap.about: §7§oMeat and berries rolled in a soft flatbread.
item.hexkagune.human_stew.about: §7§oA slow, thick stew. It warms the whole house.
item.hexkagune.crimson_risotto.about: §7§oGrain cooked down in beet and blood until it blushes.
item.hexkagune.black_risotto.about: §7§oSquid ink and ghoul meat. The dark stops being dark.
item.hexkagune.meatballs.about: §7§oRolled by hand, simmered in a red sauce.
item.hexkagune.blood_soup.about: §7§oDeep red, a swirl of cream, a sprig on top.
item.hexkagune.midnight_ramen.about: §7§oNoodles, a soft egg and seared meat, for the hours when the city sleeps.
item.hexkagune.rc_ramen.about: §7§oNoodles in RC broth. The bowl glows faintly red.
item.hexkagune.crimson_curry.about: §7§oHot enough that fire stops hurting for a while.
item.hexkagune.centipede_soba.about: §7§oBuckwheat noodles, a long strip of ghoul meat curled on top like something with too many legs.
item.hexkagune.red_hunger_stew.about: §7§oBoth meats, raw, stewed together. It quiets even a kakuja's hunger.
item.hexkagune.tide_broth.about: §7§oKelp, fish and meat. The sea lets you stay a while.
item.hexkagune.pumpkin_soup.about: §7§oSmooth, sweet and orange, meat stirred through.
item.hexkagune.forest_stew.about: §7§oMushrooms from the wood, simmered in blood.
item.hexkagune.crimson_pudding.about: §7§oA wobbling custard under a blood caramel.
item.hexkagune.meat_skewer.about: §7§oSeared meat and beet on a stick, off the grill.
item.hexkagune.kagune_kebab.about: §7§oGhoul meat grilled hard on a skewer. It bites back.
item.hexkagune.steak_dinner.about: §7§oA proper plate: the cut, a potato, a carrot.
item.hexkagune.glazed_ribs.about: §7§oSticky, sweet and falling off the bone.
item.hexkagune.blood_sausage.about: §7§oMince and blood in a casing, cured until dark.
item.hexkagune.human_jerky.about: §7§oDried in strips with a little sugar. It keeps for weeks in a coat pocket.
item.hexkagune.human_tartare.about: §7§oRaw, chopped fine, a yolk on top. For a ghoul who likes it honest.
item.hexkagune.kakuhou_tartare.about: §7§oRaw ghoul meat, the RC still alive in it.
item.hexkagune.akai_sushi.about: §7§oRed meat rolled in grain and kelp, cut into rounds.
item.hexkagune.kuro_sushi.about: §7§oGhoul meat draped over pressed grain, tied with kelp.
item.hexkagune.dumplings.about: §7§oPleated by hand, steamed, three to a plate.
item.hexkagune.spring_rolls.about: §7§oCrisp and golden, meat and carrot inside.
item.hexkagune.sunday_omelette.about: §7§oFolded soft over meat and carrot, slow on a quiet morning.
item.hexkagune.owls_omelette.about: §7§oAn old recipe, they say, from a one-eyed ghoul's kitchen.
item.hexkagune.morning_plate.about: §7§oAn egg, strips of seared meat, toast. The day starts here.
item.hexkagune.meatloaf.about: §7§oBaked in a tin with a red glaze, cut thick.
item.hexkagune.roast_haunch.about: §7§oA whole roast with an apple and berries. A feast.
item.hexkagune.meat_pie.about: §7§oGolden crust, rich filling, steam through the slits.
item.hexkagune.ghouls_pie.about: §7§oThe same crust, a darker filling. It glows through the slits.
item.hexkagune.kakuja_cake.about: §7§oA layer of ghoul meat between the sponge. Birthdays only.
item.hexkagune.velvet_cake.about: §7§oRed as it sounds, white frosting, a berry on top.
item.hexkagune.blood_cookies.about: §7§oCocoa and blood, baked by the tray.
item.hexkagune.blood_jelly.about: §7§oIt wobbles. So will you, a little higher than usual.
item.hexkagune.ghoul_mochi.about: §7§oSoft white rounds, a dark heart in each.
item.hexkagune.berry_tart.about: §7§oA short crust, a blood curd, berries.
item.hexkagune.blood_pumpkin_pie.about: §7§oAn autumn pie with a red swirl through it.
item.hexkagune.blood_truffles.about: §7§oDark chocolate round a drop of blood.
item.hexkagune.golden_heart.about: §7§oA ghoul's heart set in gold and honey. The finest thing in this book.
item.hexkagune.glow_sorbet.about: §7§oCold, bright, and it lights the way home.
item.hexkagune.anteiku_blend.about: §7§oThe café's coffee, a blood sugar cube in it. The one thing a ghoul can drink like anyone else.
item.hexkagune.blood_latte.about: §7§oMilk, coffee and blood, a heart on top.
item.hexkagune.rc_tonic.about: §7§oGhoul meat pressed into a bottle. It fizzes.
item.hexkagune.kakuja_shot.about: §7§oOne swallow. It burns all the way down.
effect.hexkagune.exhaustion.description: Your final form burned you out: War and Peace can't be called again until this wears off.
effect.hexkagune.refreshed.description: Your RC flows back on its own, a little every second.
effect.hexkagune.replenished.description: Wounds close slowly on their own, at no cost to the flesh reserve.
effect.hexkagune.content.description: Calm and happy: the frenzy ebbs, the urges quiet, and the ones you love warm to you faster.
effect.hexkagune.clear_sight.description: Blindness, darkness and nausea fall away, and you see far through water, lava and snow.
tooltip.hexkagune.kitchen.grows: §8Devoured, you'd be at: strength %s, RC lasts %s
book.hexkagune.cookbook.chapter.basics.i: Where every recipe starts: the meat, its blood, its broth.
book.hexkagune.cookbook.chapter.breads.i: Bread round meat. Quick, filling, easy to carry.
book.hexkagune.cookbook.chapter.bowls.in: Stews, soups, noodles. Slow food for a warm home.
book.hexkagune.cookbook.chapter.plates.i: Skewers, roasts, tartares, sushi: dinner on a plate.
book.hexkagune.cookbook.chapter.sweets.i: Cakes, cookies and little things to make a ghoul smile.
book.hexkagune.cookbook.chapter.drinks.i: Coffee, tea and tonics. A café's whole menu.
item.hexkagune.ghoul_cookbook.about: §7§oTouka's recipes, in her handwriting. Right-click to read.
book.hexkagune.cookbook.title: The Ghoul's Kitchen
book.hexkagune.cookbook.subtitle: Recipes for a ghoul's table.
book.hexkagune.cookbook.hunted: No recipe: it comes off a human. Find one, and catch it.
